notes:
Judge new apps and sites sooner; right-click the mascot to hide it; Mac floor

- The first check of an app or site starts half a second after it comes to the front, in the
  background, and the loop acts the moment the verdict is back (it used to wait 2s, ask, then
  wait for its next 1s tick). The loop looks twice a second instead of once.
- Right-click the penguin: hide it for 15 minutes, an hour, or the rest of the day, or turn it
  off (the same as the Settings switch). While it's hidden, things close without it.
- macOS: it stands at the bottom of the screen. The Dock is a shelf in the middle rather than a
  bar along the edge, so standing on it left the penguin in mid-air everywhere else.
